headline: IHSG Sinks, 10 Stocks Heavily Sold by Foreign Investors
summary: The IHSG index fell 1.02% on 19 November 2026. Foreign investors recorded net selling in 10 stocks during the session.
why: The IHSG is Indonesia's main stock index, tracking the Indonesia Stock Exchange. Foreign flows are a key driver of short-term moves in Indonesian equities.
why_moved: The index declined on the session, with foreign investors recording selling in 10 individual stocks, according to the report.
original_headline: IHSG Tersungkur, 10 Saham Ini Banyak Dilego Asing
